The '''Old Mankoo system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Quess sector/Legends|Quess sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Old Mankoo]].
